card.name: Numbers just before kilometers
card.fires_on: Digits or number words (and 'square') inside a metric distance or area, right before 'km' or 'kilometers'. Mostly in science and geography text that gives miles first, then the metric figure.

modes.label: Digits in km conversion
modes.description: A digit within a number placed just before km or kilometers, often in brackets after miles.
modes.example: The crater Tolkien is approximately 30 miles (4<<8>> km) in diameter.

modes.label: Square before kilometers
modes.description: The word 'square' in an area measure just before kilometers.
modes.example: has a range of about 7.7 square miles (20<< square>> kilometers)

modes.label: Other measure numbers
modes.description: Numbers before other units or counts, such as ounces or floors.
modes.example: a full glass of water (6-<<8>> ounces).
